designConsequences: The store loads the bound codec on first bound use because the retained real-process harness transpiles only the store and three v1 contract files; a static import of the bound codec would break those children.
proof.ts and operation-branch.ts import the bound modules by relative path because a retained import-graph test only allows five alias specifiers.
The challenge expiry bound is receipt time plus the 5000 ms TTL plus the 1000 ms accepted skew; a bound relative to the send time can never hold against a real engine clock.

The engine result carries an integer-only projection of the report and execution record because the canonical form forbids the float risk score; decision, action, ids, ledger attachment and risk level are carried.

The wrong-store adversary against the real engine is realised as a configuration-digest mismatch (the engine refuses before any effect); store-binding mismatch with a signed valid reply is covered against fake engines and pure engine handlers, not with a second Python bridge.
